Bestiary

Bestiary

Every sailor working the Scatter has a story. The sea that fills the space between islands is not empty — something is always in the water, in the canopy, or waiting in the dark of a sealed ruin. Some of what follows is confirmed. Some of it is rumour. The distinction matters less than you might hope.

On the Water

  • Sea Life — Ocean predators, sharks, krakens, and the things sighted from the rail at night
  • Dragons — Dragon turtles, sea serpents, and true dragons; encountering one is a survival problem, not a fight

On Land

  • Beasts — Natural predators, wildlife, and swarms across the Scatter’s islands
  • Fey — Goblin warbands found in the interior forests and hill country
  • Monstrosities — Harpies, rocs, and creatures that don’t fit a cleaner category

In the Deep Places

  • Fiends — Sahuagin who raid from the shelf walls and outer reef drop-offs
  • Plants — Myconid colonies and fungal hazards of the underdark beneath the Scatter
  • Oozes — Dissolving predators of the deep underdark; no confirmed surface sightings

The Undead

  • Undead — Pointy Hat lich variants: Hierarch (bloodline phylactery), Intoner (memory phylactery), Blight (place phylactery)

Made Things and Outliers

  • Humanoids — Pirates, admirals, and the people most likely to try to take your ship
  • Constructs — Animated objects and magical sentinels left behind in sealed halls and old collections
  • Celestials — Sacred creatures; encountering one is rarely accidental
  • Elementals — Elemental-bound creatures, including what the Ashwall pilots believe keeps the Galewall burning

For ship rules relevant to creature encounters, see Ship Stats.
